description: The standard library covers JSON, regex, paths, exact numbers, dates, enums, logging and CLIs without installing packages.
A default that returns a plausible result instead of raising: tuples as lists, float digits, naive datetimes, absolute path segments.
APIs that run code from their input (`pickle`, `eval`, `shell=True`); never feed them untrusted data.
Raised by argparse on bad arguments (status 2); it derives from `BaseException`, so `except Exception` lets it through.
